mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies cover Verona Community Park with a temperature of 51 degrees, feeling like 48. We have a waning gibbous moon tonight, and while the International Space Station passes overhead, clouds will keep it out of view.

In city news, alternate-side winter parking regulations take effect from November 20th through April 1st between 1 AM and 6 AM. Additionally, Public Works reminds residents that curbside collection is handled by Pellitteri Waste Systems, with drop-off options available for yard waste and e-waste.

For local events, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Paddy Macs and Baileys Run today. Looking ahead, yoga classes at Insight Wellness take place on Monday, November 2nd.
In police news, on Monday, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash with roadway blockage at Old PB and East Verona Avenue after both drivers entered the intersection on a yellow signal.
Over at Culver's, today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM so you can stop by for a fresh scoop.
